collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TALL TALES AND SELF-INTEREST (TT-01 to TT-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Boasting, stretched stories, little vanities, wanting the credit, the best seat or the bigger half. Most of it is harmless and funny; kind people can be boastful too. Nobody is exposed for the sake of it, and nobody needs a lesson.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager keeps the best fireside spot warm for the elders until one arrives: offer it gracefully, or make room.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every evening (subject) gets to the fire early and sits in the best spot: out of the smoke, close to the warmth, with a good tree trunk to lean on. "Just keeping it warm for the elders," (subject.he/she) says. No elder has ever sat in it. Tonight (elder), an elder, arrives, stops, and looks at the spot, and then at (subject).

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) leaps up. "There you are! I've kept it lovely and warm for you." (elder) sits down with a long, happy sigh. (subject) spends the rest of the evening on the smoky side of the fire, coughing gently, and feels quite proud of (subject.him/her)self anyway.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) shuffles along the trunk and makes room. (elder) squeezes in beside (subject.him/her). They share the best spot all evening, slightly squashed, swapping stories. The next evening (subject) arrives early as usual, and finds (elder) already there, keeping it warm for (subject.him/her).
